title: New: Open a whole UWGM Logging Session in one step
body: File → Open UWGM Logging Session... (Ctrl+Shift+O) now loads an entire session folder at once — merging the cadapp logs into the main view, and loading the optional uwgm_client and cadloader logs into their own tabs. Selecting any Call Tree / API Tree entry automatically scrolls the UWGM Client tab to the matching time window. See the User Guide for details.

title: v5.0.0 coming soon
body: A major new version, v5.0.0, is in the works! This release is expected to bring significant new features and improvements across the board. Stay tuned to this page and the Version History for the official release announcement and download.
